## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in London, United Kingdom. The listing gives its length as 1 hours, over a route of about 3.0 km. It starts at lastminute.com London Eye, Riverside Building, County Hall, London SE1 7PB, UK. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to The London Dungeon. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Discover the magic of London with a ticket to The London Dungeon included, unlocking the doors to a journey through time. Suited for those eager to see London's most iconic sights, this self-guided audio tour takes travelers on an immersive adventure at their own pace. Starting from The London Dungeon, a stone's throw away from the glittering Thames, embark on a journey weaving through the historical and cultural tapestry of the city. The path leads from the breathtaking views atop the lastminute.com London Eye to the historical beats of Big Ben's clockwork heart and Westminster Abbey’s regal towers. Continue on to uncover the secrets of the Churchill War Rooms and bask in the tranquility of St. James's Park. Art lovers will revel in the masterpieces housed in The National Gallery and the faces of history at the National Portrait Gallery. The tour concludes at the vibrant Covent Garden, where melodies and performances fill the air. The route is easy to follow, dotted with unmissable experiences of heritage and art. While the journey includes an exciting exploration of The London Dungeon's grim past, please note that an audio guide inside is not part of the package. Overall, this tour promises a collection of vivid memories and an intimate look at the heart of this bustling metropolis.
